name: Curry Salmon with Broccoli

source.cookbook: The Complete and Authentic Thai Curry Cookbook 2
source.author: Various

ingredients.item: cans condensed cream of celery soup
salmon fillets, bones and skin removed

method: Preheat the oven to 200°C/400°F. Grease a 9 × 13-inch baking dish.
Bring the water and rice to a boil in a pot. Cover, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 25 minutes.
Put the broccoli in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. In a bowl, mix the cream of celery soup, mayonnaise, white wine, and curry powder. Pour half of the mixture evenly over the broccoli.
Cut the salmon into chunks and arrange it in the baking dish. Pour the remaining soup mixture over the salmon.
Bake for about 45 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork and the broccoli is tender. Serve over the cooked rice.
